patterns.visualFunction: Make one campaign the dominant entry point through a black stage containing distinct identity, CTA, collectible, art, and controls layers.
patterns.responsive: Desktop is layered horizontally; 390px stacks art/logo/card/CTA while preserving the reading order and full card identity.
allowedTransforms: crop translation documented in asset inventory

patterns.visualFunction: Move from campaign to discovery using discrete editorial and ecosystem bands, then alternating image/copy squares.
patterns.responsive: Two-column and wide-band structures become single-column sequences; observed mobile news uses a single-card viewport with controls.
forbiddenTransforms: turn every module into identical cards

patterns.visualFunction: Contain a dense search task within a charcoal organism preceded by a light title plate and concluded by reset/search actions plus a drawer tab.
patterns.responsive: Desktop uses keyword grid and three pill columns; 390px preserves the same reading order in one vertical flow.
patterns.density: High within the bounded organism; whitespace belongs outside the task shell.
forbiddenTransforms: promote an unverified action color into a brand accent

patterns.visualFunction: Reveal authentic card results only after a query, while keeping the transition visibly reversible.
patterns.resultComposition: Light textured mosaic; four columns on desktop, reduced-column/stacked flow on phone.

patterns.visualFunction: Progressively disclose dense filter groups below the simple search without changing their semantic order.
patterns.responsive: Multi-column filter groups become stacked groups.

patterns.visualFunction: Introduce learning with a partial card fan, oversized title, then a 16:9 starter-media blade and three resources.
patterns.responsive: Two-column media and three resources become a single column; hero card becomes a cropped top band.

patterns.visualFunction: Bind definitions to an authentic full card inside a warm painted instructional field.
patterns.interaction: Only one definition panel is open; change and restoration are required.
patterns.responsive: Desktop pairs one accordion with one card; phone pairs/repeats the card beside each definition to preserve explanatory proximity.

patterns.visualFunction: Teach play locations by pairing ordered definitions with exact diagram variants inside a navy painted field.
patterns.responsive: Definition and diagram columns become ordered definition/diagram pairs.
forbiddenTransforms: one generic diagram for all definitions

patterns.visualFunction: Preserve a long page as a sequence of purpose-separated organisms with an explicit entry-to-instruction reading order, without copying any source page's colors, assets, or section skin.
patterns.responsive: Desktop and phone may reflow each organism independently, but must retain organism boundaries and entry-to-instruction order.
